scope: Diagnostic only, not adopted: strict-relative stopping plus Newmark mesh increment; linear FSI homogeneous fixed BC only. Mesh interior uses mesh beta; structural/interface nodes use FSI beta because PICC copies FSI kinematics.
derivation: PICP/PICC yield Dn-Do=dt*Yo+dt^2*((1/2-beta)*Ao+beta*An) in exact arithmetic. INITIALIZE assigns distinct FSI/mesh beta, common af. PICC copies FSI An,Yn,Dn on phys_lElas nodes, requiring FSI beta there.
